clue.text: Spirit derived from husks of grain extremely dodgy

indicators.note: taking a word to its extremes means keeping only its first and last letters

blocks.note: bran is the husk separated from cereal grain
the two end letters of the word

explanation.surface: A dubious distillery boasts of a spirit made from grain husks.
explanation.definitionFit: Brandy is a distilled liquor, and spirit is the general name for strong distilled drink.

clue.text: Confirm fight is receiving attention

indicators.note: something receiving another thing takes it in, so one piece holds the other

blocks.note: a bout is a fight, as in boxing
to give someone your ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: Someone checks that a boxing match is getting the publicity it deserves.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear out a claim is to support or corroborate it, showing it is true.

clue.text: America stops its former president getting insults

indicators.note: stopping a hole means plugging it, so one piece fills the middle of another

blocks.note: US is the United States
Abe Lincoln, a former US president

explanation.surface: The USA silences an ex-president who keeps hurling insults.
explanation.definitionFit: Abuse means insulting or offensive language, the same as insults.

clue.text: Those responsible for Liz Truss's failure (according to Liz Truss) hurtle around museum

definitions.text: Those responsible for Liz Truss's failure (according to Liz Truss)

indicators.note: turned around means facing the other way, so the word is read from end to start

blocks.note: to hurtle is to speed
the Tate is a London art museum

explanation.surface: A satirical swipe at a former prime minister blaming shadowy forces for her short tenure.
explanation.walkthrough: Liz Truss, UK prime minister for 49 days in 2022, later blamed a hidden 'deep state' establishment for her downfall.
explanation.definitionFit: The deep state is the supposed secret network of officials governing behind elected leaders, whom Truss blamed.

clue.text: Miles dumped by especially wealthy bird

indicators.note: something dumped is thrown away, so a letter is discarded from the phrase that follows

blocks.note: M is the standard abbreviation for miles
especially wealthy is most rich

explanation.surface: A man called Miles is jilted by a very rich partner.
explanation.walkthrough: Take MOST RICH and drop its M to leave OSTRICH.
explanation.definitionFit: The ostrich is a large flightless African bird, the biggest living species.

clue.text: Old Conservative to be tearful, essentially, for a month

indicators.note: the essence of a word is its core, so only its central letter is used

blocks.note: O is the abbreviation for old
C is the abbreviation for Conservative
taken as written
the middle letter of the seven-letter word

explanation.surface: An old Tory is close to tears for a whole month.
explanation.definitionFit: October is the tenth month of the year.

clue.text: Beating up inspiring director in old house

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the word is read from bottom to top
inspiring means breathing in, so one piece is drawn inside the other

blocks.note: a beating is a rout, a heavy defeat
D is the abbreviation for director

explanation.surface: A film director is beaten up in a period house.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the royal house of England from 1485 to 1603, so an old dynastic house.

clue.text: Secretly rip native off

indicators.note: something gone off has gone bad, so these letters are spoiled into another order

blocks.note: the letters as written

explanation.surface: Someone covertly cheats a local person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rip off' looks like a phrasal verb meaning cheat; the 'off' is really the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: In private means away from others' view, which is to act secretly.

clue.text: WAGs drinking in large home of iconic basketball players

indicators.note: drinking something takes it inside, so one piece swallows the other

blocks.note: WAGs are wives and girlfriends; a harem is a collection of wives
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Sportsmen's wives and girlfriends drink heavily at the home of a famous team.
explanation.walkthrough: WAGs is British slang for footballers' wives and girlfriends. The Harlem Globetrotters are the exhibition basketball team.
explanation.definitionFit: Harlem in New York gives its name to the Harlem Globetrotters, the celebrated touring basketball team.

clue.text: Prevent queen entering Irish parliament

indicators.note: something entering goes inside, so one piece is placed within the other

blocks.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen
the Dáil is the lower house of the Irish parliament

explanation.surface: Irish politicians try to stop the monarch walking into their chamber.
explanation.definitionFit: To derail a plan is to throw it off course, which stops or prevents it happening.

clue.text: Paul's second letter to the Corinthians dispatched, including message without content for fun

indicators.note: including means taking something inside, so one piece sits within the other
emptying a word of its contents leaves only its outside letters

blocks.note: the second letter of the name Paul
a letter to Corinthians, who were Greek, is a Greek letter: mu
dispatched means sent
the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A biblical scholar notes that Paul's second epistle to Corinth was sent off containing a hollow message.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface points at the Bible, but 'second letter' means the second letter of Paul, and the letter to the Greeks is the Greek letter mu.
explanation.definitionFit: Amusement is enjoyment or entertainment, which is what fun provides.

clue.text: Party with a drug cheat

blocks.note: a do is a party
a as in 'ten pounds a head', which is per

explanation.surface: An athlete is caught at a party with a drug cheat.
explanation.definitionFit: A doper is someone who takes performance-enhancing drugs, an athlete who cheats with them.

clue.text: Many deliveries of blankets banishing cold

indicators.note: banishing sends something away, so a letter is removed

blocks.note: blankets are bed covers
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A charity delivers many bundles of blankets to keep the cold away.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled, so overs are many deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: Each cricket over is six balls, or deliveries, so several overs amount to many deliveries.

clue.text: At home in inn that is purple

indicators.note: the first word goes in, inside, the word for an inn

blocks.note: someone at home is in
an auberge is a French inn

explanation.surface: Someone staying at a country inn finds the place painted purple.
explanation.definitionFit: Aubergine is the dark purple colour of the eggplant's skin, used as a colour name.

clue.text: Rig part of a pilot's training

indicators.note: training puts something through new drills, so these letters are put into a new order

blocks.note: the letters as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Learning to handle a rig is part of how a pilot is trained.
explanation.walkthrough: The rig here is a ship's rigging, not an oil rig or a cockpit.
explanation.definitionFit: A topsail is a sail set above the lowest one on a mast, a component of a sailing ship's rig.

clue.text: It grows in Earth, perhaps, on Earth?

blocks.note: Earth is an example of a planet, hence 'perhaps'
re means on, concerning
E is the abbreviation for Earth

explanation.surface: A riddle about something growing in the soil of our planet.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits the double use of Earth: once as a planet, once as the letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: A plane tree is a large tree, and any tree is something that grows.

clue.text: Mostly dismiss seaside town

indicators.note: mostly means not all of it, so the last letter is cut

blocks.note: a referee dismisses a footballer by showing a red card

explanation.surface: A seaside town is largely written off by visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: Redcar is a seaside town in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Redcar is a resort town on England's North Sea coast, so a coastal town by the sea.

clue.text: Gent's aide is working class

indicators.note: something working is being operated on, so these letters are reworked into another order

blocks.note: the letters as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A gentleman's assistant belongs to the working class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Working class' reads as one phrase; split it, 'working' is the anagram signal and 'class' the definition, a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To designate something is to classify or label it, to class it as a type.

clue.text: Underground explorers notice flies from dead bodies

indicators.note: something that flies from a place leaves it, so those letters depart

blocks.note: an ad is a notice in a newspaper
cadavers are corpses

explanation.surface: Cavers notice flies swarming off corpses found deep underground.
explanation.definitionFit: Cavers explore caves for sport, travelling below ground.

clue.text: Rest of Scottish Labour primarily supported by Brown

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter of each word is kept

blocks.note: the first letter of each of the two words
umber is a brown earth pigment

explanation.surface: Scottish Labour rests on the support of Gordon Brown, the former prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'supported by' puts the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Slumber is sleep, a state of rest.

clue.text: Pressure behind part of horse's foot

blocks.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
astern means behind, at the back of a ship

explanation.surface: A rider feels pressure behind the hoof of a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: The pastern is the section of a horse's leg between fetlock and hoof, part of the lower foot.

clue.text: Clear head? Not when exhausted

indicators.note: an exhausted word is emptied out, leaving only its outside letters

blocks.note: pate is an old word for the head
the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: Someone too tired is told their mind won't be clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Patent can mean obvious or evident, so clear in the sense of plain to see.

clue.text: No alcoholic drink (except drop of rum) in food outlet

indicators.note: except means leaving something out, so that letter is removed

blocks.note: taken as written
sherry is a fortified wine
the first letter, a small drop, of rum

explanation.surface: A restaurant serves no alcohol apart from a splash of rum.
explanation.definitionFit: A noshery is a slang word for an eatery, nosh being food.

clue.text: Endows money for project around Oregon's capital

indicators.note: one thing placed around another encloses it
'capital' keeps only the first letter of 'Oregon'

blocks.note: funds are money set aside for a purpose
the first letter of Oregon

explanation.surface: A donor pays for a scheme near Salem, the capital of Oregon.
explanation.definitionFit: To found an institution is to establish it with an endowment, so founds means endows.

clue.text: Show too much faith in something that might hinder sale of car?

definitions.text: something that might hinder sale of car?

blocks.note: first meaning: to trust someone more than is wise

blocks.clueFragment: something that might hinder sale of car?
blocks.note: second meaning, split differently: obvious corrosion on the bodywork puts off buyers

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word as OVERT RUST, visible rust; the question mark flags the punning split.
explanation.definitionFit: To overtrust is to place excessive confidence in someone, giving too much faith.

clue.text: Mind over matter finally in vogue

indicators.note: one word laid over another covers it, so it is placed around the other piece
'finally' keeps only the last letter of 'matter'

blocks.note: to mind is to tend, look after
the last letter of matter

explanation.surface: The idea of mind over matter has finally become fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: A trend is a fashion or style of the moment, which is what a vogue is.

clue.text: Good girl, one able to hold her drink

definitions.text: one able to hold her drink

blocks.note: G is the abbreviation for good
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: Praise for a young woman who can drink without getting tipsy.
explanation.walkthrough: To 'hold your drink' is to drink without getting drunk; read literally, a glass holds the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass is a vessel that literally holds a drink, so it is a container for it.

clue.text: Appropriate trousers put on, which is appropriate

indicators.note: to trouser something is to pocket it, so one piece goes inside the other

blocks.note: apt means fitting, appropriate
to put on a play is to do it

explanation.surface: Someone steals trousers and puts them on, which seems only fitting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Appropriate' appears twice: the first is the verb to take, the second the adjective apt.
explanation.definitionFit: To appropriate is to take something as one's own, as one adopts a policy or idea.

clue.text: Under no circumstances move rook to more advanced position to display courage

indicators.text: move rook to more advanced position
indicators.note: as in chess, a single piece is pushed further forward, so the order changes by one letter moving earlier

blocks.note: under no circumstances means never

explanation.surface: A chess player who never advances the rook shows a lack of courage.
explanation.walkthrough: Rook is R in chess notation; moving the R of NEVER two places forward gives NERVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerve is boldness or bravery, the courage to do something daring.

clue.text: Boycott all over the place in Indian city

blocks.note: to boycott is to ban
galore means in abundance, found everywhere

explanation.surface: Geoffrey Boycott, the Yorkshire cricketer, is everywhere on a tour of an Indian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Bangalore, now officially Bengaluru, is a major city in southern India.

clue.text: Poster about Lima is inadequate

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps around the other

blocks.note: a poster is one who posts, a sender
Lima is L in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A poster advertising Lima is judged not good enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Slender can mean meagre or scant, as in slender means, so inadequate.

clue.text: American actor to attend therapy on vacation

indicators.note: a place on vacation is vacated, emptied, so only its outside letters stay

blocks.note: to be at something is to attend it
the first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A Hollywood star has to go to therapy sessions while on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: Warren Beatty is the American actor and director.
explanation.definitionFit: Warren Beatty is an American film actor, star of Bonnie and Clyde.
